objectives.en: State who can file a complaint
Explain the three-tier redressal machinery and appeals

narration.en: You do not need a lawyer or a big court to fight a defective fridge. The Act has set up a simple three-tier system of consumer commissions.
narration.kn: ದೋಷಯುಕ್ತ ಫ್ರಿಜ್ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಹೋರಾಡಲು ವಕೀಲ ಅಥವಾ ದೊಡ್ಡ ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯ ಬೇಕಿಲ್ಲ. ಕಾಯ್ದೆ ಮೂರು ಹಂತದ ಗ್ರಾಹಕ ಆಯೋಗಗಳನ್ನು ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಿದೆ.

body.en: A complaint can be filed by a consumer, a registered consumer association, the Central or State Government, one or more consumers on behalf of many having the same interest, or the legal heir or representative of a deceased consumer. The Act sets up a three-tier machinery: District Commission, State Commission and National Commission. As given in the NCERT textbook (the 2019 Act), the District Commission hears complaints where the value of goods or services paid does not exceed ₹1 crore, the State Commission above ₹1 crore up to ₹10 crore, and the National Commission above ₹10 crore.
body.kn: ಗ್ರಾಹಕ, ನೋಂದಾಯಿತ ಗ್ರಾಹಕ ಸಂಘ, ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಅಥವಾ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರ, ಮೃತ ಗ್ರಾಹಕನ ಕಾನೂನು ವಾರಸುದಾರ ದೂರು ನೀಡಬಹುದು. ಜಿಲ್ಲಾ, ರಾಜ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಆಯೋಗಗಳು ಮೂರು ಹಂತದ ಪರಿಹಾರ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ.

narration.en: The Act sets up a three-tier machinery, with the Supreme Court above it.

say.en: The Act sets up a three-tier machinery, with the Supreme Court above it.
By claim value, as in the NCERT text: District up to 1 crore, State 1 to 10 crore, National above 10 crore.
Appeals go one step up: 45 days from the District, 30 days from the State and from the National Commission.
Reliefs include removing the defect, replacing the product, refunding the price and paying compensation.

body.en: An aggrieved party may appeal against a District Commission order to the State Commission within 45 days, against a State Commission order to the National Commission within 30 days, and against a National Commission order to the Supreme Court within 30 days. Reliefs include: removing the defect, replacing the product, refunding the price, paying compensation for loss or injury, punitive damages, discontinuing an unfair trade practice, withdrawing hazardous goods, stopping their manufacture, issuing corrective advertisement, and paying adequate costs.
body.kn: ಜಿಲ್ಲಾ ಆಯೋಗದ ಆದೇಶದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ 45 ದಿನಗಳೊಳಗೆ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಆಯೋಗಕ್ಕೆ, ರಾಜ್ಯದಿಂದ 30 ದಿನಗಳೊಳಗೆ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಆಯೋಗಕ್ಕೆ, ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯದಿಂದ 30 ದಿನಗಳೊಳಗೆ ಸರ್ವೋಚ್ಚ ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯಕ್ಕೆ ಮೇಲ್ಮನವಿ. ದೋಷ ನಿವಾರಣೆ, ಬದಲಾವಣೆ, ಹಣ ವಾಪಸ್, ಪರಿಹಾರ ಮುಂತಾದ ಪರಿಹಾರಗಳಿವೆ.

problem.en: A builder fails to hand over a flat for which the buyer paid ₹4.5 crore. Under the limits in the NCERT text of the 2019 Act, where should they file, and where can they appeal if unhappy?

steps.en: The value paid, ₹4.5 crore, is above ₹1 crore and not more than ₹10 crore.
So the complaint goes to the State Commission.
An appeal against the State Commission's order lies with the National Commission within 30 days.

answer.en: State Commission; appeal to the National Commission within 30 days.
